item.description: Picture this: It’s lunchtime in the 1960s, and you’re out with co-workers enjoying not one, not two, but three cocktails with your meal. While the three-martini lunch seems improbable today, workplaces still can be boozy places.

item.title: China sets a lower economic growth target of 4.5% to 5% for 2026 as challenges loom
item.description: BEIJING (AP) — China signaled continuity rather than change for its economy, announcing Thursday a slightly lower target for growth this year in the midst of a property slump and other headwinds at home and growing uncertainty abroad.
